messages:
Priya Nair: Hi team — noticed my 11/30 paycheck withheld NY state tax and OR state tax. I moved from NYC to Portland on 2025-09-10 and updated my profile but the stub still shows NY + OR withholding. Net down ~$360.
Sam Hollis: @Priya thanks for the heads up. Can you share the payrun id and last four of your employee id so payroll can pull the record?
Priya Nair: payrun PR-20251130-11, emp 6124. Paystub lines show NY withheld $180.32, OR withheld $179.45. I stopped traveling to NY after 9/10.
Payroll Bot: Auto-ticket created: PAY-5931. Vendor: ADP. Priority: high. Assigned: Rosa Vega.
Rosa Vega: looping in — thanks @Priya. Two likely causes: (1) vendor residency flag still set to NY, (2) company still has NY worksite mapping for you. I'll check both. Did you complete the state residency change form or provide proof of new residence?
Priya Nair: I updated address in self-service and uploaded a lease to the profile in HR portal on 9/12. I didn't realize a separate state form was needed.
Sam Hollis: For midyear moves, ADP needs a state nonresident or resident withholding form submitted to stop previous state's withholding. We can do a retro adjustment once forms are in. Also need to confirm any NY-sourced days after 9/10 for tax apportionment.
Rosa Vega: I'm pulling the vendor record now. Vendor shows residency: NY, and withholding start date still flagged as 01/01/2025 for NY. That explains continued NY withholding. I've attached the OR OR-W4 equivalent and NY nonresident affidavit to ticket PAY-5931.
Payroll Bot: Attachments uploaded to PAY-5931: OR withholding form, NY part-year/nonresident affidavit.
Priya Nair: Thanks. If we do retro adjustments, will my 2025 W-2 show NY wages? Will you issue a corrected W-2?
Rosa Vega: Yes, initial W-2 will reflect the tax filings as processed. We'll request retro reallocation of state wages and withholding with ADP, and if necessary file amended state returns and issue a corrected W-2 (W-2c) or state equivalents. Typical vendor turnaround 3-6 weeks, state processing may add time.
Sam Hollis: Also note: if the refund is issued by the state directly (some states refund to employee), we may not be able to intercept. If ADP issues payroll-level refund, it may appear as an off-cycle adjustment. We'll track which path ADP takes.
Priya Nair: Ok. I pay quarterly estimates — will this create a gap where I end up underpaid to OR?
Rosa Vega: We'll generate a summary showing corrected wage allocations and withheld amounts once ADP completes recalcs. Use that to adjust your Q4 estimate. If you want, I can send a PDF with corrected figures when available.
Tax Counsel: tagging to advise on cross-state residency: if you spent >30 days in NY after 9/10 for client meetings, NY could still source some wages. Please keep a short travel log for September-December.
Priya Nair: I had a 2-day client visit in Manhattan on 10/22. Everything else was remote. I'll add travel log to the ticket.
Rosa Vega: Thanks. Priya please sign and upload the NY nonresident affidavit + OR resident withholding form to PAY-5931 by EOD and we'll push the retro request.
Priya Nair: Uploaded both forms and added travel log. 
Payroll Bot: PAY-5931 status: awaiting payroll ops review. ETA first vendor response: 3 business days.
Sam Hollis: Thanks all — we'll post vendor updates here. Priya, expect a follow up about whether ADP will issue payroll refund or state refund routing.
Priya Nair: Appreciate it. Will monitor and let you know if I see any more double withholding.
